name: slider
title: Slider
description: A slider on Base UI's Slider: one value or a range with two thumbs, horizontal or vertical, on a size.track track with an accent indicator, in three thumb sizes.

manifest.name: slider
manifest.title: Slider
manifest.description: A slider on Base UI's Slider: one value or a range with two thumbs, horizontal or vertical, on a size.track track with an accent indicator, in three thumb sizes.
manifest.usage: Use Slider for a value in a known range where the position matters more than the exact number (a sample percentage, a zoom level), or for a range with two thumbs. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel, and show the current value in the label or next to it; name each thumb of a range with getAriaLabel. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur (onValueCommitted for work that should run only when the user lets go). For an exact number, use NumberInput, or pair the two.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value; an array of two for a range.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled; its length sets the number of thumbs.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called while the value changes (dragging, keys).

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called when the user lets go or a key step ends.

props.name: step
props.description: The arrow-key step and the grid values snap to.

props.name: minStepsBetweenValues
props.description: The least distance between the thumbs of a range, in steps.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Vertical sliders take their height from the layout.

props.name: size
props.description: Thumb size from size.icon.sm, md or lg.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The thumb's name when there is no FieldLabel.

props.name: getAriaLabel
props.description: Names each thumb of a range.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name; a Field's name wins.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction and dims the slider.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: control
slots.description: The hit area, size.control.xs across; data-slot="slider-control".

slots.name: track
slots.description: The track, size.track thick in color.border.default; data-slot="slider-track".

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: The selected part of the track in the accent solid; data-slot="slider-indicator".

slots.name: thumb
slots.description: A thumb with a native <input type="range"> inside; data-slot="slider-thumb".

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over a thumb: its border turns the accent solid.

states.name: dragging
states.description: While dragging: the thumb's border is the accent solid.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on a thumb: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field: the thumbs' border is color.status.danger.border.

accessibility: Each thumb holds a native <input type="range">, so screen readers announce it as a slider with its value, and Tab reaches each thumb.
Arrow keys move by step, PageUp/PageDown and Shift+arrow by largeStep, Home and End to min and max.
A FieldLabel names a single thumb; name both thumbs of a range with getAriaLabel ("Minimum length", "Maximum length"). Use format so units are announced.
The thumb has a color.border.strong border (3:1 against the surface and the track); the selected part is the accent solid.
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the thumb (3:1 on every surface).
